label: Finding-26
title: no-confirmed-compromise: Claim text lacks its as-of and scope
description: The negative holds only "in every captured source, as of the latest capture" (newest checked 2026-10-22T11:33Z). The note says so, but the claim and status "confirmed" read as a settled fact about the world. The supporting negatives are old: Huntress as of 20:30Z on 21 Oct, Imperva pre-disclosure only, CERT.LV 20:00Z on 21 Oct, against Amazon's "broadly exploited in the wild" and Cloudflare's "millions" of attempts. Suggest status "reported" or wording "No named organisation, in any captured source as of <stamp>, ...".
